items.name: Apple Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Fall in love with our Heart-Shaped Apple Strudel. Thinly sliced apples, cinnamon, and sugar in a flaky, golden crust, a symphony of sweetness. Enjoy the heartwarming flavour in each delightful bite of this uniquely shaped pastry, adding a touch of romance to a timeless treat.

items.name: Durian Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Indulge in our Heart-Shaped Durian Strudel, a daring culinary adventure! This unique pastry melds the bold durian flavor with a flaky, golden crust for a one-of-a-kind treat. Each bite offers the exotic allure of durian, perfect for adventurous palates.

items.name: Mango Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Indulge in romance with our Heart-Shaped Mango Strudel. Bursting with exotic sweetness, the flaky, golden crust encapsulates the essence of indulgence. Savour the luscious flavour in every bite for a delightful journey into mango bliss.

items.name: Strawberry Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Delight in the sweetness of our Heart Shaped Strawberry Strudel. A perfect harmony of strawberries encased in a flaky, golden crust, this treat is a burst of fruity goodness in every bite.

items.name: Peach Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Savour sweet romance with our Heart-Shaped Peach Strudel. Juicy peaches, delicately sweet, encased in a golden, flaky crust, a delightful blend of fruity goodness. Share a blissful moment with this uniquely shaped pastry, promising a taste of love in every peach-infused bite.

items.name: Blueberry Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Indulge in sweet and tangy bliss with our Heart-Shaped Blueberry Strudel. Bursting with juicy blueberries in a golden crust, it's a delightful blend of romance and fruity goodness to share joy in every bite.

items.name: Chocolate Heart Shaped Strudel (S)
items.description: Savour decadence with our Heart-Shaped Chocolate Strudel. Rich, velvety chocolate encased in a flaky, golden crust creates a romantic treat. Each bite promises a symphony of cocoa goodness and love.

items.description: Our Crispy Tiramisu Cream Puff features a crisp choux pastry shell filled with a rich, coffee-infused cream, inspired by classic tiramisu. Topped with cocoa powder, it combines a crunchy exterior with a smooth, velvety center for a perfect coffee-flavoured treat.

items.description: Indulge in the perfect fusion of crispy outer shell and creamy custard filling with our crispy custard cream puff. Every bite delivers a delightful contrast of textures and a burst of rich, velvety flavour.

items.name: Salted Egg Fish Skin
